# Data dictionary

The curated tables, rebuilt from the staged layer on every run. Public tables
are published on the dashboard and as downloads; the others contain
station-level data and stay where the pipeline runs
([ADR 0002](decisions/0002-what-is-published.md)).

| Table | Published | Key |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`fuel_price`](#fuel_price) | no | `station_cnpj`, `product`, `collected_on` |
| [`station`](#station) | no | `station_cnpj` |
| [`usd_brl_daily`](#usd_brl_daily) | yes | `observed_on` |
| [`ipca_monthly`](#ipca_monthly) | yes | `month` |
| [`agg_price_weekly_national`](#agg_price_weekly_national) | yes | `survey_week`, `product` |
| [`agg_price_weekly_region`](#agg_price_weekly_region) | yes | `survey_week`, `region_code`, `product` |
| [`agg_price_weekly_state`](#agg_price_weekly_state) | yes | `survey_week`, `state_code`, `product` |
| [`agg_price_weekly_flag`](#agg_price_weekly_flag) | yes | `survey_week`, `product`, `flag_type` |

## fuel_price

Every price ANP collected: one row per station, product and collection date, with the repetition between ANP's semester, monthly and four-week files removed.

File: `curated/fuel_price/year=*/data.parquet`.

| Column | Type | Null | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `station_cnpj` | VARCHAR |  | CNPJ of the station, 14 digits. |
| `product` | VARCHAR |  | Fuel, under the name ANP gives it. One of: GASOLINA, GASOLINA ADITIVADA, ETANOL, DIESEL, DIESEL S10, GNV, GLP. |
| `collected_on` | DATE |  | Day the price was collected at the station. |
| `survey_week` | DATE |  | Sunday that starts the ANP survey week of the day. |
| `sale_price` | DOUBLE |  | Price charged at the station, in BRL per unit. |
| `purchase_price` | DOUBLE | yes | Price the station paid its distributor; ANP stopped publishing it in 2020. |
| `unit` | VARCHAR |  | Unit of the prices: BRL per litre, per cubic metre (GNV) or per 13 kg cylinder (GLP). One of: BRL/L, BRL/m3, BRL/13kg. |
| `state_code` | VARCHAR |  | State (UF), two letters. One of: AC, AL, AM, AP, BA, CE, DF, ES, GO, MA, MG, MS, MT, PA, PB, PE, PI, PR, RJ, RN, RO, RR, RS, SC, SE, SP, TO. |
| `region_code` | VARCHAR |  | Region: N, NE, CO, SE or S. One of: N, NE, CO, SE, S. |
| `municipality` | VARCHAR |  | Municipality of the station, as ANP writes it. |
| `brand` | VARCHAR |  | Distributor brand (Bandeira) on that day; BRANCA means unbranded. |
| `source_kind` | VARCHAR |  | Kind of ANP file the row was taken from. One of: semester, monthly, last_four_weeks. |
| `source_period` | VARCHAR |  | Period of that file: a semester (2026-S1), a month (2026-10), latest for the rolling file of the last four weeks, or the collection date of an earlier version of that file kept as a snapshot. |
| `n_candidates` | BIGINT |  | How many rows of ANP's files carry this station, product and date (ANP publishes an observation in up to three files). |
| `price_conflict` | BOOLEAN |  | True when those rows do not all give the same sale price. |

## station

Every station ANP surveyed: one row per CNPJ, with the name, brand and address of its most recent observation.

File: `curated/station.parquet`.

| Column | Type | Null | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `station_cnpj` | VARCHAR |  | CNPJ of the station, 14 digits. |
| `station_name` | VARCHAR |  | Registered name (Revenda). |
| `brand` | VARCHAR |  | Distributor brand (Bandeira); BRANCA means unbranded. |
| `street` | VARCHAR | yes | Street. |
| `street_number` | VARCHAR | yes | Street number, free text. |
| `address_complement` | VARCHAR | yes | Address complement. |
| `neighbourhood` | VARCHAR | yes | Neighbourhood (Bairro). |
| `postal_code` | VARCHAR | yes | CEP, 8 digits. |
| `municipality` | VARCHAR |  | Municipality, as ANP writes it. |
| `state_code` | VARCHAR |  | State (UF), two letters. One of: AC, AL, AM, AP, BA, CE, DF, ES, GO, MA, MG, MS, MT, PA, PB, PE, PI, PR, RJ, RN, RO, RR, RS, SC, SE, SP, TO. |
| `region_code` | VARCHAR |  | Region: N, NE, CO, SE or S. One of: N, NE, CO, SE, S. |
| `first_seen` | DATE |  | First day a price was collected at the station. |
| `last_seen` | DATE |  | Latest day a price was collected at the station. |
| `n_observations` | BIGINT |  | Rows the station has in fuel_price. |
| `n_names` | BIGINT |  | Distinct registered names over its history. |
| `n_brands` | BIGINT |  | Distinct brands over its history, all products together. |

## usd_brl_daily

The US dollar in Brazilian reais: one row per day with a rate (Banco Central, SGS series 1).

File: `curated/usd_brl_daily.parquet`.

| Column | Type | Null | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `observed_on` | DATE |  | Day of the rate; business days only. |
| `usd_brl` | DOUBLE |  | Reais per US dollar, selling rate. |

## ipca_monthly

Consumer price inflation (IPCA): one row per month, with the index and the deflator derived from it (Banco Central, SGS series 433).

File: `curated/ipca_monthly.parquet`.

| Column | Type | Null | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `month` | DATE |  | First day of the month. |
| `pct_change` | DOUBLE |  | IPCA change within the month, in percent. |
| `index` | DOUBLE |  | Chained index: 100 in the month before the first one. |
| `deflator_to_latest` | DOUBLE |  | Multiply a price of this month by it to express it in reais of the latest month with a published IPCA. |

## agg_price_weekly_national

Weekly price statistics per product for the whole country, with the dollar and the inflation adjustment of the week. Rows built from fewer than 3 stations are not published, and weeks without a survey have no rows.

File: `curated/agg_price_weekly_national.parquet`.

| Column | Type | Null | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `survey_week` | DATE |  | Sunday that starts the ANP survey week, which runs to Saturday. |
| `product` | VARCHAR |  | Fuel, under the name ANP gives it. One of: GASOLINA, GASOLINA ADITIVADA, ETANOL, DIESEL, DIESEL S10, GNV, GLP. |
| `unit` | VARCHAR |  | Unit of the prices: BRL per litre, per cubic metre (GNV) or per 13 kg cylinder (GLP). One of: BRL/L, BRL/m3, BRL/13kg. |
| `n_stations` | BIGINT |  | Distinct stations behind the figures of the row. |
| `n_observations` | BIGINT |  | Prices collected; more than n_stations when a station was surveyed twice in the week. |
| `price_mean` | DOUBLE |  | Mean price over the stations, each counting once; not weighted by sales volume as ANP's official averages are, so it differs from them. |
| `price_median` | DOUBLE |  | Median of the station prices. |
| `price_p10` | DOUBLE |  | 10th percentile of the station prices (linear interpolation). |
| `price_p90` | DOUBLE |  | 90th percentile of the station prices (linear interpolation). |
| `n_states` | BIGINT |  | States with at least one price in the week, including states whose own row is not published. |
| `usd_brl_mean` | DOUBLE | yes | Mean of the daily dollar rates dated within the week; empty when there is none. |
| `ipca_deflator` | DOUBLE |  | IPCA deflator of the month of the week's Wednesday; 1 when provisional. |
| `ipca_provisional` | BOOLEAN |  | True when that month has no IPCA yet, so the week is not deflated. |
| `price_mean_real` | DOUBLE |  | price_mean x ipca_deflator: the mean in reais of the latest IPCA month. |

## agg_price_weekly_flag

Weekly price statistics per product for unbranded and branded stations (the six automotive fuels; GLP is not covered). Rows built from fewer than 3 stations are not published, and weeks without a survey have no rows.

File: `curated/agg_price_weekly_flag.parquet`.

| Column | Type | Null | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `survey_week` | DATE |  | Sunday that starts the ANP survey week, which runs to Saturday. |
| `product` | VARCHAR |  | Fuel, under the name ANP gives it. One of: GASOLINA, GASOLINA ADITIVADA, ETANOL, DIESEL, DIESEL S10, GNV, GLP. |
| `flag_type` | VARCHAR |  | white_flag for unbranded stations (brand BRANCA), branded for the others. One of: white_flag, branded. |
| `unit` | VARCHAR |  | Unit of the prices: BRL per litre, per cubic metre (GNV) or per 13 kg cylinder (GLP). One of: BRL/L, BRL/m3, BRL/13kg. |
| `n_stations` | BIGINT |  | Distinct stations behind the figures of the row. |
| `n_observations` | BIGINT |  | Prices collected; more than n_stations when a station was surveyed twice in the week. |
| `price_mean` | DOUBLE |  | Mean price over the stations, each counting once; not weighted by sales volume as ANP's official averages are, so it differs from them. |
| `price_median` | DOUBLE |  | Median of the station prices. |
| `price_p10` | DOUBLE |  | 10th percentile of the station prices (linear interpolation). |
| `price_p90` | DOUBLE |  | 90th percentile of the station prices (linear interpolation). |
